testsuite.name: com.aura.companion.ui.chat.ChatViewModelTest

testcase.name: a stream that opens but says nothing still falls back
dismissing an error leaves the conversation intact
retry resends a failed message without retyping it
a streamed reply grows one bubble and settles it
a new conversation clears the transcript
a refused WebSocket falls back to REST and still answers
an empty or whitespace draft is not sent
a blank companion message is ignored
a socket that closes mid-reply still settles the bubble
an unconfigured server refuses to send and says why
a healthy server names its provider in the banner
nothing is sent while a reply is still arriving
a probe rejected on the token is promoted to an error
a companion message tapped from a notification appears once
a failed send keeps the message and offers it back
a rejected token is surfaced rather than silently retried
an unreachable server is reported without an error banner
a stream that fails after text is reported rather than re-asked
